resources.string: One line for each feed page FeedClean looked at: which player it was in (For You, another Home tab, search, other), what was detected, the decision, and why auto-skip did or didn\'t run. Also late labels and the overlay card\'s results. No names, handles, captions, or other screen text. Kept on this phone for 7 days, at most about 5 MB.
The decision log is off (Settings → Data & privacy). Nothing new is recorded; what is already here is shown below.
